# 0.6.1 beta 6 — Per-device airing choices and reliable automatic control

- Opening requests name the room without reading contact-sensor names. Closing
  requests name the room and the friendly names of the windows that are open.
  Both explain the action's reasons, including applicable outdoor cautions.
- Add **Ask to open windows** to eligible indoor remediation devices, including
  air purifiers, humidifiers, dehumidifiers and thermal controllers. The option
  defaults to **off**; devices then follow normal demand without an airing wait.
  Each device has its own **Window opening wait (min)** from **0–30 minutes**,
  default **5**. Zero removes the added delay. Both controls remain editable
  while the physical appliance is offline.
- When the option is enabled and airing can reduce the same measured problem,
  include the device's friendly name and wait time in the opening request.
  Start its deadline only after accepted delivery. A failed submission releases
  the start; repeated advice does not extend the deadline or endlessly rearm it.
  Devices with different timeouts wait independently. Existing room-controller
  paths retain the shared timeout setting.
- Resume normal device control after an unanswered request expires, including
  native DRY-mode dehumidifiers. Recheck demand and operating protections before
  starting. An unrelated CO₂ request no longer delays a dehumidifier or purifier.
  Keep the selected room feedback sensor authoritative; do not substitute a
  different physical humidity reading for a configured room measurement.
- Keep Automatic/PID selected when the appliance has not acknowledged HEM's
  requested state. Retry every minute while demand and authority remain valid,
  announce after three unsuccessful dispatch attempts, and continue retrying.
  Skipped unavailable checks are not attempts. A genuine manual change after
  confirmed HEM control retains the existing user-override protection.
- Fix a saved PID/Automatic method incorrectly asking for selection again when
  room sensor configuration changes. Bind authorization to the same physical
  device and registered control endpoints in the same room, preserving checks
  for replaced or moved hardware.
- Forward enabled AI announcements to Announcement Hub with its supported AI
  rewrite options. Send complete reasons, cautions, device names and timeouts;
  the Hub owns the rewrite and delivery without a second local AI rewrite.
- Add native settings and translated labels across all 38 supported languages,
  controller-specific card controls, and regression tests for actual native
  starts, retry recovery, authorization, announcement payloads and mobile UI.

Install **0.6.1b6**, restart Home Assistant and refresh the HEM card. Enable
**Ask to open windows** separately on each device where you want this behavior,
then choose its wait time. Existing window protections, presence policies and
minimum ON/OFF times continue to apply. This release has automated runtime and
browser coverage; physical appliances still need observation after installation.
Existing releases, assets and tags are retained.
